name: step_start
description: Start a step: an agent working in a workspace. Returns the step id.

schema.description: JSON schema of the step's return value

name: step_status
description: Report a step's current state by id.

name: step_stop
description: Stop a running step by id.

name: step_resume
description: Resume a step a usage limit holds by id.

name: step_wait
description: Wait until one of the given steps ends, or until timeoutSeconds passes (at most 1500 seconds). Returns the ended step, or null with every step's state at timeout.

name: epic_create
description: Create an epic from an accepted contract. decisions seeds the epic's recorded decisions. workflow names the workflow the epic pins, epic by default. Returns the stored epic. A refusal names the field that failed.

contract.description: the accepted contract in protobuf JSON field names: id, repository, title, approved, intent, failures, care, additions, requirements, premises, exclusions, approach, alternatives, releaseSteps, releaseThen, checks, base, gates, doneGates, reviewers. A requirement carries item, its evidence: capture, limit, artifacts, supplied, conclusion, judge, kind and tests. Each entry of reviewers carries name, enabled, stage, must, mustNot, prompt, agent, model, tools, effort, limit and verify.

workflow.description: the workflow the epic pins, read at the contract's base: a repository file .orrery/workflows/<name>.yaml, else the built-in of that name; omit it to pin epic

name: epic_get
description: Return a stored epic by id: its contract, the workflow it pins with its name, text and sha256, phase, timestamps, decisions, whether it is paused and why it is parked, and its planner turns, tasks and questions.

name: epic_list
description: List the stored epics as summaries: id, repository, title, phase, created and changed.

name: epic_answer
description: Record a decision on an epic. question names the Q<n> the decision answers, and choice names the choice it gives: a declared choice's id, or other, which needs text. A decision with no question is a note, which takes no choice and returns a warning naming the questions still open. A decision id already recorded with the same text returns the stored decision; other text under that id is refused. Returns the decision and the warning.

text.description: the owner's words: required with choice other, optional with a declared choice

question.description: the Q<n> the answer names; omit for a note

choice.description: the choice the answer gives the question: a declared choice's id, or other; omit for a note

name: epic_follow
description: Return how often the owner took the advice of each question label, across all epics: per label, the answered questions that had a recommendation and how many were answered with it.

name: epic_pause
description: Pause an epic by id, so the planner starts no turn for it and no limit reset resumes it. Returns the stored epic. An epic the owner paused, or paused with no recorded source, is refused; an epic a usage limit paused is accepted and stays paused past the reset.

name: epic_resume
description: Clear the pause of an epic by id, if it is paused, and resume its limited task steps. Returns the stored epic, the ids of the steps resumed, and the ids of the steps a full step cap left limited. An epic that is not paused and holds no limited task step is refused. A park stays; epic_retry ends a park.

name: epic_stop
description: Pause an epic by id and stop the step of its running turn. Returns the stored epic. An epic with no running turn is refused, and nothing is stopped, unless it holds its repository's release slot: then the slot is freed, its open release step is stopped if one runs, and the epic is not paused. epic_release resumes a stopped release.

name: epic_retry
description: End the park of an epic by id, so the planner starts its turns again. With node, rerun the parked workflow node of that id under its next attempt instead, which also ends the park. Returns the stored epic. Without node, an epic that is not parked is refused; with node, a node that is not parked is refused.

node.description: the workflow node id whose parked run reruns under its next attempt; omit to end the epic's park

name: epic_kick
description: Kick an epic by id: record text as the owner's decision and wake the epic's planner with it at the epic's next plan run. Refused for a paused epic, for a parked epic (epic_retry ends the park first), and for an epic in an ended phase, which takes no kick. Returns the stored epic.

text.description: the owner's words, which the planner reads at the epic's next plan run

name: epic_release
description: Release an epic by id. A stopped release resumes at its first unfinished step, and undoNone names the 1-based positions of undo-none release steps to run again. An epic that ended with gaps is released on the owner's word, logged as the owner's decision, so undoNone must be empty for it. Returns the stored epic. Refused unless the release is stopped or the epic ended with gaps, and each position is undo-none.

undoNone.description: the 1-based positions of the undo-none release steps to run again; omit to name none

name: evidence_run
description: Run an item's evidence at a revision for one phase, red or green. Returns the evidence run. A refusal names the field that failed.

name: evidence_get
description: Return one artifact of an evidence run by its path, or the run's log when name is omitted. The bytes are base64 in the result.

name.description: the artifact's repository-relative path; omitted for the run's log
